en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside town beneath a steep, rocky, forested cliff. A row of multi‑storey houses and hotels lines the riverbank, with boats or a steamer moored at a quay in the foreground. The massive rock face rises directly behind the buildings, topped by trees and a small structure on the summit. Hills covered in forest extend into the background. Printed captions in German at the top read "Schäferwand." over the cliff and "Bodenbach a. d. Elbe." on the right, indicating the location by the Elbe River.
